technology_decision: Retain CPython buffered-line orchestration for the replay preload subcomponent: bounded C-backed reads feed the exact core in-process, discard padding and result accumulation, and preserve a validated snapshot without a second file read; measured allocation reduction justifies this implementation, not a CPU speed claim.
scope: P1.3 replay preload only; clock/calibration, acquisition/decoder/inference and process-isolation technology comparisons remain open. P1.3 is not yet fully technology-reviewed.

alternatives.assessment: Credible bounded native I/O; a direct buffer can enforce the same read ceiling but needs an FFI/process boundary or duplicate core validator to populate the worker. No performance comparison or disqualification of Rust for other P1.3 components is claimed.
Bounded native buffered reads compose with the existing core stream interface and keep one validated snapshot; selected for this preload boundary.
Credible acquisition candidate with queue bounds/drop behavior; not an NDJSON protocol validator. Carry into the remaining P1.3 decoder review.
